newsitem.title: UK: UK MEALS AND FEEDS LOWER, TRADE QUIET.
newsitem.headline: UK MEALS AND FEEDS LOWER, TRADE QUIET.

text.p: UK meals and feeds sellers were easier on Tuesday with business quiet ahead of the USDA crop report.
Brokers were pinning their hopes on the USDA report to trigger some business, but when the Chicago soy futures opened higher interest dried up.
"How can they push soybeans higher when faced with a record crop? There is no sense in that market," said one broker.
The USDA forecast the 1997/98 (Sept/Aug) soybean crop at 2.744 billion bushels, 15 percent higher than last year's output and above trade expectations for 2.607 billion to 2.731 billion.
Most sellers on the UK market took around one stg out of their soymeal prices during the morning.
But only one trade was reported prior to the Chicago opening when spot high protein soymeal fetched 193.50 stg a tonne ex-store east coast.
